### Borea v0.2.0-dev.1: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.2.0 before it is released.
It is not for playing. For normal use, stay on v0.1.0.
v0.2.0 follows in a few days.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### New since v0.1.0

- Borea updates itself: "Update now" on the Home banner, or `borea update-self`. This is the first build that can do it, so from here you get v0.2.0 without a manual download.
- Mod packs: create an instance from a pack, and move it to a newer or older pack version.
- Mods on disk: Borea can take over a mod it did not install, finds mods whose folder is gone, and checks free disk space.
- Saves and vehicles: restore and delete backups in the App.
- Browsing: the index refreshes while Borea runs, a mod page shows its dependencies, and a back control returns to the last page.
- Sharing: every listing has a web page, and `borea://` links open it in Borea on Windows and Linux.
- Mod authors: write, check and send a listing from the App.
- Launching: Core loads before the mods, and a StarMap crash names the likely mod.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on, and the change takes effect at the next start.
When v0.2.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
